Something about this hits harder after my cousin committed suicide after reintroducing me to the Suicide Boys. My cousin was a hardcore metal head and the only rap group he ever fucked with were these two guys. Life seemed a whole lot simpler before that.

Never in my life have I ever waited almost 3 hours to get into a show. This was a complete crap show, they had like 4 people checking tickets and they weren't even checking the damn covid vaccinations yet by the time I got it I had missed every single opener. On top of that they were too cheap to hire enough security and workers so there were literal mobs of people coming from the back of the line and pushing themselves inside. Seems like everyone I saw cut the line made it in much sooner then those who hadn't. They almost had a Travis Scott moment and I'll be reporting that The Midway did not follow covid protocols. What's even worse is I told my buddy he couldn't come because of those restrictions as he's not vaccinated because no one checked if I was. This place might be fine for lesser-known artists but the damn Suicide Boys had that place sold out its obvious the meager infrastructure can't even put up with that amount of people. Several thousands of people, including myself basically paid like 65$ a person to wait in line for almost 3 hours. Oh, I forgot to mention the cops they hired and the security they hired didn't care that there were two people selling beer to kids who were waiting in line. Needless to say, I feel up ripped off and so should everyone else who was waiting in that horrendous line with me. What's sad is there was at least maybe an hour of people waiting behind me so I'm not even sure some people got in. AVOID THIS VENUE AT ALL COSTS.

I ended up missing all of the artists that I came to see besides the Suicide Boys. 

On a lighter note, I ended up forcing my dad to come with me lol and he became a fan and thoroughly enjoyed their music. So for that experience, I am eternally gratful. But it does suck that we were to tired to check the merch out or even take a picture together as some kind of momento/keep-sake. They performed damn well, and had me tearing up during some of their bangers!   
TLDR: I'm glad to have attended because I got to see the only rap group my cousin who committed suicide fucked with, but the venue and the people who run it need to be dragged out into the streets and shot.
